source: previous full train/val label inventory reused after SHA verification; no new model scoring or test read
label_definition: normal iff next-character y_id equals the train modal class; all other y proxy anomalies
score_direction: higher NLL or categorical probability-onehot MSE => anomaly; positive_label=1
normal_source: modal next-character y class from train only
limitations: proxy labels are not semantic anomaly annotations
high anomaly prevalence makes high AP alone weak evidence
fixed speaker roles and exact-input quarantine do not prove semantic independence
same number of rows is insufficient to establish a paired cohort; exact frozen IDs/hashes required
